findings.reason: the plan committed to resolve-in-the-comparison against the owner; landing it as a parallel query leaves exactly the mirrored-scalar drift the decision was written to prevent.
findings.text: the post-copy divergence guard resolves `physics_domain` with its own Cypher (`sn.physics_domain` when set, else `collect(DISTINCT src.physics_domain)`), a second implementation of the resolution rule that `_candidate_physics_domains` (export.py:1530) already owns; the plan's own `post-copy-domain-comparison` decision says "the exporter owns the resolution rule and the guard should read the same rule rather than a snapshot of it", and the two will drift the moment either changes

findings.reason: the added re-check is load-bearing and correct (it blocks the manifest write); the finding is a placement preference, not a defect that changes what the plan lands.
findings.text: the design's "empty export filters every candidate and exits 0" repair now re-checks emptiness after the gate block, but it does so through a second `_export_population_issue` call at the catalog-write boundary in addition to the pre-gate call, rather than extending the single population gate; the design text treats "re-evaluate after the gate" as a new test point without saying why the existing population gate cannot be moved to cover the filtered set

findings.reason: each added option is unaccounted surface; the section must name what it retires or state why the existing option cannot be extended.
findings.text: the plan routes repair and composition through CLI surface (`sn retry --failed`, `sn run --only review --edits`, `sn run --compose-model`, a rehearsal command) and no section states what each retires or merges and why nothing can be, against this week's supplied counts of 0 for every family

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the landed machinery resolves to focused functions over the existing SN package (`_rehearse_export_accounting` catalog_release.py:1731, `_freeze_review_artifact` catalog_release.py:1587, `_export_population_issue` export.py:914) that hide the accounting/gating behind one call each rather than a spread of wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the guard resolves physics_domain with its own Cypher rather than calling the exporter's rule, which the plan designated as owner.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the design adds CLI surface (`sn run --only review --edits` scope, a rehearsal command, `--compose-model` routing) and no section names what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design cites existing owners by file:line and extends them (`reclassify_standard_name_domain` graph_ops.py:143, `EXACT_SOURCE_RESET_APPLY` provenance_lifecycle.py:918, `claim_explicit_standard_name_sources` graph_ops.py:10337), and the post-copy-domain decision explicitly names the exporter as the owner to read rather than mint a mirror.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — the design forecloses reuse of the exporter's domain-resolution rule by re-deriving it as an independent query in the post-copy guard.
